Entry contract: v28, 2026-10-05.

| ▶ **recall** · where the project stands and what comes next |
|---|
| ↳ **q-0001.0016** · How is each turn steered from the store? |
| ? **uncharted** · What kind of person would do the work we do in this repo? |

## Where the project stands

- **In flight:** [01-0011.0100.0040 the-turn-is-steered-from-the-store](docs/tickets/01-0011.0100.0040-the-turn-is-steered-from-the-store.md) is implemented and verified. One acceptance box is left: a fresh session's wake shows a process row, and its first question shows a `↳` or `+` row. This session is that fresh session.
- **Uncommitted work:** six files from today's maintenance pass and the closing of q-0024.0006 "Is an ADR or a ticket the home for a decision?" (the entry moved to `docs/questions/done/`). Committing needs your word.
- **One decision waits for you:** q-0026.0003 "What does an entry-contract version cover?". Another running session is already on it.
- **Next in the queue, unchanged:** [01-0011.0100.0050 a-question-branches-before-it-is-answered](docs/tickets/01-0011.0100.0050-a-question-branches-before-it-is-answered.md), starting with its align, then [01-0014 scope-coherent](docs/tickets/01-0014-scope-coherent.md). I found nothing that calls for reordering.
- **Other sessions:** six are marked running. Four have no position, one is on q-0026.0003, and one is on q-0001.0016. Some may be stale rows.
- **Nothing due:** no straw dogs are due and nothing is suspect. The two deferred questions (q-0001.0013 on reused ids, q-0006 on a composite rule set) have not met their conditions.

## The validation check

- **Entry line and `/recall` first:** both fired.
- **Process row at the wake:** shown above.
- **The `↳` row:** it comes from the wake rule, not from your question. I placed this session on q-0001.0016 because your message as a whole is a check of turn steering.
- **Your literal question:** no question in the store contains it. The nearest is q-0016 "What is an agent role, and which mechanism keeps roles?", but that only resembles it: it is about agents' permissions, not about a person. So I did not open or attach it.

Whether this mixed outcome ticks the last box is your call. The box asks for the first question to get a `↳` or `+` row, and the question itself got a `?` row.

**Where does your question belong?** Either name a parent for it, or say it was only a probe and I will drop it.

My short answer to it meanwhile: an editor of law more than a programmer. The work here is wording rules so they fire at the right moment, keeping every fact in one home, and refusing to decide anything on top of a question that is still open.
